title: Question 13
passage:
Why are we leaving the old prices on the shelves for now?
A. The registers won't switch to the new prices until closing. B. The new price labels are in the office. C. We keep last year's price lists in a separate folder.
passageZh:
為什麼目前還保留貨架上的舊標價？
A. 收銀系統要等到打烊才會切換成新價格。
B. 新的標價牌在辦公室。
C. 我們把去年的價格表放在另一個資料夾。
